name: 59-vitest-mock-path-root-prefix
title: Simplify root prefix checks in resolveMockPath
body: resolveMockPath now compares the mocked path directly against config.root and the /@fs/ root, dropping the withTrailingSlash helper and its import.

bugs.why: A plain startsWith(config.root) also matches sibling directories like /project-utils when root is /project, so paths outside the root get wrongly sliced into root-relative URLs.
Same missing path-boundary check for the /@fs/ root: /@fs/project-utils/x is treated as inside /@fs/project.
